name: je-income-tax-compliance
description: Jersey income-tax compliance reference checked in October 2026, covering ordinary personal and company return deadlines, late-return penalties, abatements, default assessments, correction routes, appeals and late-payment surcharges. Use for Jersey tax penalties, assessment appeals, correcting a return or distinguishing tax filing from payment. Preserves statutory conditions, separate notice periods and the obligation to pay estimated tax during an appeal. Includes hypothetical calculations and reviewer controls. It does not calculate personal instalment formulas, handle a dispute or submit anything. GST, social contributions, MCIT, prosecution and complete enforcement procedures require their own verified sources.
